decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the firm’s core offer and still shown in 2024, it likely embodies meaningful technical investment and strategic fit, so management would tend to continue it rather than admit a premature misstep.

This 2024 product was launched very visibly on its own page, fits the firm’s push into higher-value semiconductor processing, and is too new for management to stop before it can justify the investment as still ramping up.
